title: Paying ATO (with AmEx) after Credit Card Surcharge Ban
body:
Hi everyone,
With the ban on credit card surcharges, I am wondering if its better to pay the ATO using the AMEX Platinum card directly or alternatively go via provider such as Sniip.
My understanding is that ATO spend does count towards the minimum credit card spend required for hitting the bonus rewards points.
However, AMEX states that you earn "1 point per $1 spent on purchases at government bodies in Australia" but "2.25 points per $1 spent on other purchases".
Happy to hear your thoughts.
